description: ranked_by 复用单次重排结果，避免 cross_encoder 路径重复打分（保留去重+heuristic 排序）
anchor:
ranked = _rerank(query, all_results)[:max_results]
    return {
        "query": query,
        "variants": _query_variants(query),
        "engine": "+".join(engines),
        "region": _region(),
        "ranked_by": "cross_encoder" if _cross_encoder_rank(query, ranked) is not None else "heuristic",
        "results": ranked,
    }
patch:
deduped = _dedup_results(all_results)
    ce = _cross_encoder_rank(query, deduped)
    ranked = (ce if ce is not None else _heuristic_rank(query, deduped))[:max_results]
    return {
        "query": query,
        "variants": _query_variants(query),
        "engine": "+".join(engines),
        "region": _region(),
        "ranked_by": "cross_encoder" if ce is not None else "heuristic",
        "results": ranked,
    }
